question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Linger
solution:
The correct answer is '**Leave**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Linger**' is '**Leave**'.
 
• **Linger**: to stay somewhere or do something for longer than usual. (किसी जगह देर तक रुके रहना या कोई काम देर तक करते रहना)
 
 
• *Example: His eyes **lingered** on the money in her bag.*
 
 
 
• **Leave**: to go away from somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से दूर जाना)
 
 
• *Example: We should **leave** now if we’re going to get there by eight o’clock.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Leave.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Choose**: to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available. (उपलब्‍ध वस्‍तुओं या व्‍यक्तियों में से चयन या चुनाव करना; चुनना)
 
• **Entertain**: to interest and amuse somebody in order to please him/her. [किसी का जी बहलाना (ताकि वह ख़ुश रहे)]
 
• **Annoy**: to make somebody angry or slightly angry. (किसी को क्रोधित या नाराज़ करना; परेशान या तंग करना; ग़ुस्‍सा दिलाना)
